UserAccount.title: User Account
UserAccount.description: Private authenticated account root containing account metadata and active profile pointer.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was last updated.

ViewerProfile.title: Viewer Profile
ViewerProfile.description: Individual viewer profile nested under a user account with independent watchlist, ratings, and watch history.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parent account owner.

avatarColor.description: Tailwind gradient class for the profile avatar.

isKids.description: Whether this profile is a Kids-focused profile.

favoriteGenres.description: Bounded list of up to 20 preferred genres.

preferredPlatforms.description: Bounded list of up to 15 preferred streaming services.

watchlist.description: Bounded list of up to 500 saved media IDs.

liked.description: Bounded list of up to 500 liked media IDs.

disliked.description: Bounded list of up to 500 disliked media IDs.

watchHistory.description: Bounded list of up to 200 watch progress records.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account documents indexed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/profiles/{profileId}.description: Subcollection of viewer profiles belonging to a user account.
